facts.fact: Forum on Information and Democracy and ALCRER state that Benin has no specific, sufficiently binding AI regulation or liability regime for AI uses, and no specific AI regulatory authority.

BEN.note: Recommendations only; no government AI use stated.

facts.fact: Forum on Information and Democracy and ALCRER state that outside the national AI and big-data strategy 2023-2027, Benin has no specific and sufficiently binding regulation on developing, deploying or using AI systems.
The brochure refers to Benin's national AI and big-data strategy 2023-2027 as the existing national framework to which the April 2024 workshop adapted the recommendations.

BEN.note: No AI model, dataset or computing facility stated; research access only recommended.
Only recommends transparency of the electoral roll; no register status stated.
Complaint portals only recommended, none stated in service.
Workshop of 17 April 2024 discussed a report's recommendations, not a named Benin digital law or policy put to outside parties.
